source_name: European Digital Finance Association — event listings for Balkan payments events
why_relevant: Aggregator/partner listing that mirrors Balkan payments event descriptions, partner lists and dates; useful as a redundant pointer when organiser sites are rebuilt between editions.

source_name: Western Balkans Digital Summit (RCC) — programme and participants
why_relevant: Annual intergovernmental digital summit for WB6 (2025 edition Skopje, 1-2 October, hosted by the Ministry of Digital Transformation) covering digital public services, interoperability, digital wallet. Kosovo ministries and BQK participate; a prior edition carried a dedicated 'Digital payments in the Balkans' session. Programme names the vendors and donors around Kosovo's digital-identity/payment agenda.

source_name: Digital Watch Observatory — session archive for Balkan digital/payments summits
why_relevant: Independent archive of summit sessions with speaker names and affiliations, preserved after organiser sites go offline. Valuable for reconstructing historic Kosovo payments panels.

source_name: Global Finance Magazine — Best Bank / Best Digital Bank award announcements (CEE, incl. Kosovo)
why_relevant: Country-level award citations for Kosovo (BKT Kosova named Best Bank in Kosovo 2025, fifth consecutive year). Award write-ups describe implemented digital solutions in case-study detail without the NDA filter that constrains vendor references. Awards are run in partnership with Infosys — itself a vendor signal.

source_name: BKT Kosova — award and sponsorship newsroom
why_relevant: Winning banks publish the fullest description of what was awarded — BKT Kosova on 'Banka më e mirë në Kosovë 2025' (Global Finance) and 'Banka më e mirë Digjitale në Kosovë' (Euromoney). These releases routinely name the digital channel, platform or partner behind the win, and also list the bank's own event sponsorships.

source_name: Banka Ekonomike — conference participation and event notes
why_relevant: Example of a Kosovo commercial bank documenting its own participation in the BQK annual conference. Bank newsrooms are a reliable secondary index of which forums each bank attends and sponsors — the demand side of the partnership map.

source_name: Balkan Fintech Association
why_relevant: Regional fintech body whose co-founder (Linda Shomo) speaks at Kosovo fintech events; likely publishes member lists, events and partner rosters spanning XK/AL/MK/RS — a regional overlay on the Kosovo partnership map.

source_name: IBAS — Kosovo banking/fintech events and synergy conferences
why_relevant: IBAS appears both as a KFF sponsor and as an organiser/reporter of bank-fintech synergy events in Kosovo; its blog documents which banks and fintechs sat on which panel — a low-noise partnership trace.

source_name: AmCham Kosovo — conferences, press releases and archive
why_relevant: Business chamber that runs sponsored conferences and recognitions in Kosovo (e.g. recognising ProCredit Bank for responsible finance) and hosts the National Council on Economic Development. Sponsor and awardee lists identify vendor-bank relationships; the archive site preserves older press releases.

source_name: CBCG FinTech Hub / FinTech Hackathon (Montenegro) — regional template and sponsor roster
why_relevant: Central-bank-run fintech hackathon in the Western Balkans, co-run with ICT Cortex and hosted on TAIKAI. Sponsor/partner and challenge lists show which vendors court regional central banks; a close analogue and likely template for any future BQK-side initiative, and Kosovo teams may participate.

source_name: Udruženje banaka Srbije (Association of Serbian Banks) — events and digital banking committee
why_relevant: Serbian-language regional benchmark: runs a traditional annual conference with the Chamber of Commerce and the insurers' association, and maintains a dedicated digital banking committee among 14 expert committees. Its events and the Adria Media 'Digitalno bankarstvo i osiguranje' expo zone list vendor exhibitors active across the region, several of which also sell into Kosovo.

source_name: Adria Media Group — 'Digitalno bankarstvo i osiguranje' expo zone (exhibitor directory)
why_relevant: A structured virtual expo directory for Serbian/regional digital banking and insurance — effectively a machine-readable exhibitor and sponsor roster, the single densest sr-language vendor list found in this cell.

source_name: Fintechnews.ch — European fintech events calendar (regional discovery)
why_relevant: Editorial calendar of continental European fintech events used to discover new regional forums that Kosovo/WB banks and their vendors attend; a cheap way to find events not yet indexed locally.

source_name: AllEvents — Kosova Finance Forum listing (venue/date archive)
why_relevant: Third-party listing preserving venue (Emerald Hotel), dates and organiser handles for Kosovo finance events after organiser pages rotate; useful for reconstructing an event timeline.

source_name: Posta e Kosovës — Payment Services (Shërbimet e pagesave)
why_relevant: Posta e Kosovës is licensed by BQK as a Non-Banking Financial Institution and runs the country's largest non-bank bill-payment counter network (Kos-Giro, Treasury revenue collection, commercial biller agreements). Its service page enumerates which billers/institutions it has signed, which is the single best public map of non-bank acceptance and disbursement volume in Kosovo.

source_name: Posta e Kosovës — Procurement / Prokurimi publications
why_relevant: Tender and award notices from the post office reveal which IT/payment vendors supply its counter systems, terminals, reconciliation and postal software — supplier identification the bank-only view misses.

source_name: BQK — Përdorimi i kartelave në Kosovë / Korišćenje kartica na Kosovu (card usage report)
why_relevant: Central Bank statistical report on card and POS terminal usage (e.g. 17,187 POS terminals installed end-2023, ~90% contactless). Gives the denominator for acceptance-estimate work and is published in sq/sr/en, satisfying local-language coverage.

source_name: BQK — Institucionet Financiare të Licencuara (register of licensed financial institutions)
why_relevant: Authoritative actor list for this cell: microfinance institutions (IMF), non-bank financial institutions (IFJB), non-bank payment service providers (OSHP jo-bankë), e-money institutions, insurers and FX offices. Every new licence is a new buyer of core, terminal and reconciliation systems.

source_name: BQK — Rregullore për qasjen e ofruesve të shërbimeve të pagesave jo-banka në sistemet e pagesave
why_relevant: Regulation opening interbank payment-system access to non-bank PSPs — the legal trigger that lets telcos, post, MFIs and payment agents plug directly into rails, creating new integration/vendor demand. Track for effective dates and access conditions.

source_name: Capital Ria (Capital-KS) — licensed payment institution with agent network
why_relevant: Non-bank payment institution with a wide agent network handling utility bills, all regional water companies (Prishtina, Gjakova, Hidromorava, Hidroregjioni Jugor), telecom/internet/TV bills, vehicle insurance and registration, property tax and university fees. Its biller list is effectively a directory of who has outsourced acceptance, and it is itself a buyer of agent-terminal and reconciliation software.

source_name: VllesaPagesa — bill payment service
why_relevant: Second identified Kosovo non-bank bill-payment operator; competitor/peer to Capital Ria and a buyer of agent terminal and biller-integration technology. Site lists supported billers.

source_name: Paysera Kosova
why_relevant: Foreign e-money/payment player with a Kosovo presence; LinkedIn page surfaces hiring, partnership and merchant-acquiring announcements that signal new acceptance channels for non-bank buyers.

source_name: KESCO — electricity supplier payment channels (Pagesa e energjisë elektrike / eKesco)
why_relevant: KESCO is the largest single biller in Kosovo. Its payment help pages enumerate accepted channels — counters, eKesco app with domestic and international Visa/Mastercard, direct web payment, third-party agents — identifying the acquirer/PSP behind each channel and any new acceptance partner it adds.

source_name: KRU Prishtina — online bill payment / eKRUP
why_relevant: Largest regional water company; recently launched online invoicing and payment (eKRUP). Regional water companies (KRU Prishtina, Gjakova, Hidromorava, Hidroregjioni Jugor) are a repeatable cluster of billing-system and payment-acceptance buyers, and are also public contracting authorities on e-Prokurimi.

source_name: Telekomi i Kosovës / Vala — Njoftime (announcements)
why_relevant: Vala is the incumbent mobile operator and a business unit of PTK. Its announcements page carries service launches, partnerships and tender/procurement notices — the primary channel for any telco top-up, mobile-payment or billing-system move by the largest state-owned telecom buyer.

source_name: IPKO Telecommunications — corporate site
why_relevant: Second mobile operator (majority-owned by Telekom Slovenije), a private buyer of billing, top-up-distribution and payment-acceptance technology and a likely partner in any mobile-money or carrier-billing launch. Product and news pages reveal new payment/self-care services.

source_name: ARKEP — Regulatory Authority of Electronic and Postal Communications (market reports)
why_relevant: Sector regulator for both electronic communications AND postal services — the two rails in this cell. Its periodic market reports carry operator subscriber/revenue data and its postal register lists licensed postal operators (relevant to cash-on-delivery and counter payments). URL inferred from the regulator's name and citations; treat as unverified until the liveness pass runs.

source_name: AMIK — Association of Microfinance Institutions of Kosovo
why_relevant: Trade body for the MFI sector; publishes member lists, sector history and committee structure. Members identified include KEP Trust, FINCA Kosovë, KRK (Kreditimi Rural i Kosovës), AFK (Agjencioni për Financim në Kosovë), Besëlidhja and Kosinvest — a ready-made buyer list for core banking, digital lending, agent and collection technology.
